title: Group sessions by their current term status. For each group, state the stat
question: Group sessions by their current term status. For each group, state the status ('CURRENT' if is current term and 'NOT CURRENT' otherwise), name of the session, number of IAP sessions, total IAP session time in days, and average IAP session time in days. Show a subtotal for each current status and a grand total row across all status. Order the results by current status and cluster type. Display the the current status only if it differs from the previous entry.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NOT CURRENT' END AS current_status,
    iss.SESSION_TITLE AS session_name,
    isc.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS cluster_type,
    iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY,
    (TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_DATE, '%d-%b-%y'), STR_TO_DATE(iss.SESSION_DATE, '%d-%b-%y')) + 1) AS session_time_days
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd ON at.TERM_CODE = isd.TERM_CODE
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY isc ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN GROUPING(current_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(cluster_type) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN GROUPING(cluster_type) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      ELSE current_status
    END AS status_display,
    CASE
      WHEN GROUPING(current_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(cluster_type) = 1 THEN 'zzz'
      ELSE current_status
    END AS status_sort,
    CASE
      WHEN GROUPING(cluster_type) = 1 THEN 'zzz'
      ELSE cluster_type
    END AS cluster_sort,
    cluster_type,
    session_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS num_sessions,
    SUM(session_time_days) AS total_time_days,
    AVG(session_time_days) AS avg_time_days
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_status, cluster_type, session_name
  WITH ROLLUP
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(status_display) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, cluster_sort) = status_display THEN NULL
    ELSE status_display
  END AS current_status,
  session_name,
  cluster_type,
  num_sessions,
  total_time_days,
  avg_time_days
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY status_sort, cluster_sort

s.window_column), Subquery2 AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_KEY, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, SUM(ss.LAB_UNITS) AS total_lab_units, NULL AS window_column, 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment' AS Reason FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.SUBJECT_KEY, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), subquery2 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), CombinedResults AS (SELECT 'Highest Variance Year' AS Result_Type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.Most_Represented_Department, s1.Subject_Count, NULL AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, NULL AS `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS base GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), DepartmentsWithHighVariance AS (SELECT DISTINCT dept FROM Subquery1 WHERE NOT catalog_key_variance IS NULL) SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM Subquery2 AS s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN (SELECT dept FROM DepartmentsWithHighVariance) ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT css.SUBJECT_TITLE, css.TERM_CODE, css.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, css.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, css.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, css.SCHOOL_NAME, css.max_num_enrolled_students, mts.min_academic_year, mts.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS css JOIN MathTermStats AS mts ON css.TERM_CODE = mts.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.max_num_enrolled_students, ic.min_academic_year, ic.avg_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ic.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.TERM_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_num_enrolled_students, m.min_academic_year, m.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS c JOIN MathTermStats AS m ON c.TERM_CODE = m.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.TERM_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) - MIN(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_range, VARIANCE(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_variance, STDDEV(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment_stddev FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION), Subquery1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_range, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_variance, inner_cte1.max_enrollment_stddev, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte1 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON inner_cte1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM `TIME_DAY` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.CALENDAR_DATE, icte.DAY_OF_WEEK, icte.window_column, at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at2.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM inner_cte2 AS icte JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at2 ON icte.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.max_enrollment_range, s1.max_enrollment_variance, s1.max_enrollment_stddev, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.CALENDAR_DATE, s2.DAY_OF_WEEK, s2.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.max_enrollment_range DESC

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE,     CASE WHEN at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' THEN 'CURRENT' ELSE 'NOT CURRENT' END AS current_status,

  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL isd ON at.TERM_CODE = isd.TERM_CODE
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION iss ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = iss.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY
  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY isc ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN GROUPING(current_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(cluster_type) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN GROUPING(cluster_type) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      ELSE current_status
    END AS status_display,
    CASE

  JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY isc ON isd.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = isc.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN GROUPING(current_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(cluster_type) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL'
      WHEN GROUPING(cluster_type) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
      ELSE current_status
    END AS status_display,
    CASE
      WHEN GROUPING(current_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(cluster_type) = 1 THEN 'zzz'
      ELSE current_status
    END AS status_sort,
    CASE
      WHEN GROUPING(cluster_type) = 1 THEN 'zzz'
      ELSE cluster_type
    END AS cluster_sort,
    cluster_type,
    session_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS num_sessions,
    SUM(session_time_days) AS total_time_days,
    AVG(session_time_days) AS avg_time_days
  FROM base
  GROUP BY current_status, cluster_type, session_name
  WITH ROLLUP
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(status_display) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, cluster_sort) = status_display THEN NULL
    ELSE status_display
  END AS current_status,
  session_name,
  cluster_type,
  num_sessions,
  total_time_days,
  avg_time_days
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY status_sort, cluster_sort
